name: Watsuji Aya
source:
A girl bereft of her shadow and afraid of shadows, who alone keeps protecting the "everyday life" in the city of the full moon that has descended into lunatic stillness. Why does she go to such lengths to keep up the everyday life? And when will her futile battle end?

[Translated from [url=http://www.shall-luck.co.jp/interlude/h1.html]the official site[/url]]
